test_dataframe_value_counts_default: test the DataFrame value_counts method to count unique row combinations sorted by frequency
test_dataframe_value_counts_unsorted: test the DataFrame value_counts method with sort=False to return counts without sorting
test_dataframe_value_counts_normalize: test the DataFrame value_counts method with normalize=True to return proportions instead of counts
test_dataframe_value_counts_dropna: test the DataFrame value_counts method with dropna=False to include rows containing NaN values
test_dataframe_value_counts_subset: test the DataFrame value_counts method with a subset parameter to count only specified columns
